title: Council Order 0015402: building classification and fire-protection / occupant-safety orders for a turbine building at an oil facility (ABC 1997)

facts.text: Seven orders dated 2011-06-08 were issued by the accredited municipality against an oil company; the appeal concerns the Boiler Feedwater/Combustion Turbine Generator Complex at an oil facility.

The two issues were (a) the appropriate building classification of the complex under ABC 1997 Part 3, and (b) whether its fire-protection features were built to good fire-protection engineering practice and the intent of ABC 1997 for fire protection and occupant safety.
The appellant argued for Group F, Division 3, one storey, low fire occupancy, or a special and unusual structure, citing a very low occupant load and direct communication with emergency services.

The operative clauses revoke the ABC 1997 Section 3.4 'Exits' order and vary the fire-alarm determination (Subsection 3.2.4), requiring a fire alarm system in accordance with that subsection and referenced NFPA or CSA standards.
A further direction requires fixed fire suppression and detection systems around the pumps on the main floor of the boiler feedwater area.
